entities.summary: Cecilia Muñoz is an American public policy expert who served as Director of the White House Domestic Policy Council under President Obama, a position she held for five years. Prior to that, she served as the White House Director of Intergovernmental Affairs for three years.

entities.name: Cecilia G. Muñoz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Cecilia Muñoz is an American public policy expert who served as Director of the White House Domestic Policy Council under President Obama, a position she held for five years. Prior to that, she served as the White House Director of Intergovernmental Affairs for three years.
